task_description: Build Thinkr — a premium AI study companion for Indian students (Class 6-10). React+Vite+TypeScript+Tailwind+Framer Motion+Dexie+pdfjs+Tesseract+MiniSearch+Recharts+KaTeX. PWA with Netlify edge function proxy to Groq/OpenRouter. Full 19-phase implementation: design system, data layer, SVG assets, layout, landing page, onboarding, library, chat/tutor, study/quiz, marks card analysis, progress/report card, daily planner, voice tutor, gamification, demo mode, profile, architecture page, Netlify proxy, final config.
